string.text: Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Suppressor mount
Special threading used for attaching a suppressor.
Rail mount
Allows to install various types of sights.
Tactical foregrip
Improves handling, therefore facilitates recoil management. Includes a tactical handguard replacement, that is equipped with Weaver rails. Allows to install additional tactical accessories.
Laser sight

Provides a visual point of reference, visually marks the expected point of impact, facilitates and speeds up aiming, and has a demoralizing effect on the enemy. Does not interfere with the tactical flashlight and can be installed along with it.
Tactical flashlight
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
Recoil pad
Hard rubber recoil pad reduces felt recoil.
Improved feeding mechanism
Individual adjustment of every part of the feeding mechanism decreases the probability of feeding issues.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Rebored barrel
Increases muzzle velocity, thus increasing the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Recoil compensator
Reduces felt recoil by diverting combustion gases.
Balanced bolt
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces the muzzle climb and bullet dispersion.
More durable parts
Parts made of extremely durable alloys and application of a protective coating to the internal mechanisms of the firearm improve its wear-resistance.
Improved ejector
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their modern light-alloy counterparts.
